spans.s:
r. 1st cl. (जलति)
1 To be sharp.
2 To be wealthy.
r. 1st and 10th cls. (जलति जालयति)
To cover, to hide or veil; to cover also as with a net, to encompass.

mfn. (-लः-ला-लं)
Cold, stupid, apathetic, idiotic, &c.
n. (-लं)
1

Water.
2

A kind of perfume: see ह्रीवेर.
3 The uterus of a cow.
4 Frigidity, (moral, mental, or physical.)
E.
जल to hide, to encompass, &c. affix अच्; also ल being changed to its congener ड, जड q. v.

n. (-लं)
1 A net.
2 A window, a lattice, an eyelet or loophole.
3 A multitude, an assemblage.
4 An unblown flower.
5 Pride, arrogance.
6 Magick, conjuring, illusion, super-natural [] deception.
m. (-लः)
1 The Kadamba tree.
2 The young fruit of a gourd or cucumber.
f. (-ली)
1 A small cucumber, (Trichosanthes diœca, Rox.)
2 Any medicament or drug.
E.
जल to encompass, to hide or screen, affix अण्.

n. (-कं)
A conch, a shell.

f. (-का)
A leech.
E.
जल, and अक to go, अच् aff.

n. (-कं)
1 A bud, a germ. An unblown flower.
3 A nest.
4 A net.
5

Pride.
6

A plantain, the fruit.
7 Multitude, assemblage.
m. (-कः)
A window, a lattice, a loop or eyelethole.
f. (-लिका)
1 Armour, chain armour.
2 A kind of cloth or raiment, woollen cloth.
3 A leech.
4 A window.
5 Iron.
E.
जाल, and कन् added, or जल to enclose, वुन् aff.

m. (-कः)
1 An aquatic plant, (Trapa bispinosa.)
2 A crocodile.
E.
जल water, and कण्टक a thorn.

m. (-पिः)
The gangetic porpoise.
E.
जल, and कपि an ape, the water-ape.

mfn. (-रः-री-रं)
Making or shedding water.
m. (-रः)
Rent or tax derived from water, for fisheries, &c.
E.
जल, and कर tax or what makes.

m. (-रः)
A piece of water, a spring, a fountain.
E.
जल, and आकर a mine.

m. (-ङ्कः)
1 A cocoanut.
2 A shell or conch.
3 A lotus.
4 A cloud.
5 A wave.
E.
जल water, and करङ्क a cup or receptacle.

m. (-ल्कः)
Mud, mire.
E.
जल water, and कल्क sediment.

m. (-कः)
The diver.
E.
जल, and काक a crow; the water-crow.

m. (-ङ्क्षः)
An elephant.
E.
जल water, and काङ्क्ष desirous, from काक्षि with अच् affix; also with इनि affix, ut infra^1.
[1] Correction submitted by Dr. Sampada Savardekar on 20210731. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/csl-corrections/issues/66.

mfn. (-ङ्क्षी-ङ्क्षिनी-ङ्क्षि)
Desirous of water, fond of water.
m. (-क्षी)
An elephant.
E.
जल, and काङ्क्षिन् wishing: see the last.

m. (-रः)
A name of VARUṆA.
E.
जलकान्त the water-gem, the ocean, and अर who goes or rules.

m. (-टः)
A shark, or according to some, a large alligator.
E.
जल water, किर a hog, and अट who goes.

f. (-टी)
The black-headed gull: see गङ्गाचिल्ली.
E.
जल water, and कुक्कुटी a fowl.

m. (-भः)
A sort of aquatic bird.
E.
जल water, and कुक्कुभ a wild fowl.

m. (-लः)
An aquatic plant, (Vallisneria.)
E.
जल water, and कुन्तल hair.

m. (-कः)
An aquatic plant, (Trapa bispinosa.)
E.
जल, कुब्ज to be crooked, affix क्वुन्.

f. (-पी)
1 A whirlpool.
2 A pond, a pool.
3 A spring, a well.
E.
जल water, कूप a well, ङीष् affix of diminution.

m. (-र्म्मः)
The gangetic porpoise.
E.
जल, and कूर्म्म a tortoise, a water tortoise.

f. (-या)
A funeral ceremony, presenting water to the manes of the deceased.
E.
जल, and क्रिया ceremony.

m. (-शः)
1 A plant, (Vallisneria.)
E.
जल, and केश hair; spreading over the water like dishevelled hair.

f. (-डा)
Sporting or gamboling in water, bathing for pleasure or amusement.
E.
जल, and क्रीडा pastime, play.

m. (-ल्मः)
1 A whirlpool.
2 A turtle, a tortoise.
2 A piece of water, a lake.
E.
जल water, and गुल्म a lump like the spleen, or a cluster.

mfn. (-ङ्गः-ङ्गा-ङ्गं)
Aquatic, frequenting or going to water.
m. (-ङ्गः)
The colocynth.
E.
जल, and ग what goes.

m. (-मः)
A Caṇḍāla, an outcaste.
E.
जल water, and गम who goes; who goes to fish for his subsistence; also जनङ्गम q. v.

mfn. (-रः-री-रं)
Aquativ, amphibious, going in or into water.
E.
जल, and चर what goes.

mfn. (-री-रिणी-रि)
Aquatic, living in or frequenting water.
m. (-री)
A fish.
E.
जल water, and चर to go, affix णिनि.

mfn. (-जः-जा-जं)
Water-born, aquatic.
m. (-जः)
1 A fish.
2 Any aquatic animal.
n. (-जं)
1 A lotus.
2 A shell.
f. (-जा)
A plant; said to be a sort of bassia growing in or near water.
E.
जल, and ज produced.

m. (-न्तुः)
A fish, or any marine, aquatic, or amphibious animal.
E.
जल water, and जन्तु animal.

f. (-का)
A leech.
E.
कन्, and टाप् added to the preceding.

n. (-न्म)
A lotus.
E.
जल, and जन्मन् birth.

m. (-ह्वः)
A crocodile.
E.
जल cold, and जिह्वा a tongue.

m. (-म्बः)
A bivalve shell.
E.
जल, and डिम्ब a young animal.

m. (-ङ्गः)
1 A wave.
2 A metal cup with water, so as to produce a harmonic note like a musical glass.
E.
जल, and तरङ्ग a wave.

m. (-कः)
1 The Hilsa or sable fish, (Clupanodon ilisha, HAM.)
2 Another kind of fish, commonly Caöuchi, (Cyprinus cachius, HAM.)
E.
जल water, तप to inflame, ठक affix; also with णिनि affix जलतापिन् m. (-पी) The Hilsa.

m. (-लः)
The Ilīśa or Hilsa fish: see the last
E.
जल water, तल to abide, affix घञ्.

f. (-त्रा)
An umbrella.
E.
जल rain, and त्रा defending, from त्रै, with ड and टाप् affs.

mfn. (-दः-दा-दं)
Giving or shedding water.
m. (-दः)
1 A cloud.
2 A fragrant grass, (Cyperus rotundus.)
E.
जल water, and द what gives.

f. (-ङ्क्तिः)
A line or succession of clouds.
E.
जलद, and पङ्क्ति a line.

f. (-तिः)
Cloudiness, gathering of clouds.
E.
जलद, and संहति assemblage.

m. (-मः)
The rainy season.
E.
जलद, and आगम arrival.

n. (-नं)
Giving water.
E.
जल, and दान giving.

mfn. (-भः-भा-भं)
Dark, black.
E.
जलद a cloud, and आभ what resembles.

m. (-मः)
The Śāl tree, (Shorea robusta.)
E.
जलद a cloud, and अशन imbibing, from अश to eat, affix ल्युट्.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
Holding or having water.
m. (-रः)
1 A cloud.
2 The ocean.
3 A grass, (Cyperus rotundus.)
E.
जल water, and धर containing, possessing, from धृ with अप् aff.

m. (-रः)
A pond, a lake, a reservoir, any piece of water.
E.
जल, and आधार a receptacle.

f. (-ला)
1 A row of clouds.
2 A species of the Jagatī metre.
E.
जलधर, and माला a garland.

m. (-धिः)
1 The ocean.
2 A large number, (a hundred lacs of crores).
E.
जल water, धा to have, and कि aff.

f. (-गा)
A river.
E.
जलधि the sea, गा going.

f. (-जा)
A name of the goddess LAKṢMĪ.
E.
जलधि, and जा produced, the ocean-born; appearing at the churning of the ocean, amongst the fourteen precious things recovered from it.

m. (-लः)
An otter.
E.
जल, and नकुल an ichneumon; the water-ichneumon.

m. (-धिः)
The ocean.
E.
जल water, and निधि a nest.

m. (-मः)
A drain, a water-course, a pipe along a wall or building for carrying off water, a waterfall, the descent of a spring, &c. into a river below.
E.
जल water, निर्गम transit or passage.

m. (-हः)
A quantity of water.
E.
जल, and निवह a quantity.

f. (-ली)
Vallisneria.
E.
जल, and नीली a blue dye or indigo; imparting its own tinge to the stream.

m. (-रः)
An Asura sprung from ŚIVA, and adopted by the ocean.
E.
जलं, and धर who has.

m. (-रः)
The name of a country situated in the northwest of India, apparently part of Lahore, and perhaps the modern Jallindhar.
m. plu. (-रः)
The inhabitants of Jālandhara.

n. (-लं)
1 A quantity of water.
2 A cloud.
E.
जल, and पटल a quantity.

m. (-तिः)
1 VARUṆA, the deity presiding over the watery element, the Hindu

Neptune.
2

The ocean.
E.
जल, and पति lord or master.

n. (-त्रं)
A drinking vessel.
E.
जल, and पात्र vessel.

n. (-नं)
Drinking water: in Bengal, refreshment, luncheon.
E.
जल, and पान drinking.

m. (-त्तः)
Fire.
E.
जल, and पित्त bile; being as adust to water as bile is to the body.

f. (-ली)
An aquatic plant, (Commelina salicifolia, &c.) see जलभू.
E.
जल water, and पिप्पली long-pepper.

f. (-जा)
An aquatic plant, (Pistia stratiotes.)
E.
जल water, पृष्ठ back or surface, and ज produced.

n. (-यं)
A country abounding with water.
E.
जल, and प्राय abundance.

f. (-या)
Armour, iron network, or chain armour.
E.
जाल a net, and प्राय resembling.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
Fond of water, frequenting water.
m. (-यः)
1 The Cātaka, (Cuculus melanoleucos.)
2 A fish.
E.
जल water, and प्रिय fond of.

m. (-वः)
An otter.
E.
जल water, and प्लव who goes or swims.

n. (-नं)
An inundation, a deluge.
E.
जल, and प्लावन overflowing.

m. (-कः)
A dam, a dike, rocks or stones impeding a current.
E.
जल water, and बन्धक confining.

m. (-न्धुः)
A fish.
E.
जल water, and बन्धु a friend.

n. (-दं)
A bubble of water.
E.
जल water, and बुद्वुद a bubble.

f. (-ह्मी)
A kind of potherb, (Hilancha repens.)
E.
जल, and ब्रह्मी an asclepias.

mfn. (-भूः-भूः-भु)
Aquatic, produced in or by water.
m. (-भूः)
1 A cloud.
2 An aquatic plant, (Commelina salicifolia or bengalensis): see कञ्चट.
E.
जल water, and भू being or born.

f. (-का)
A water insect.
E.
जल, and मक्षिका a fly.

m. (-द्गुः)
A kingfisher.
E.
जल, and मद्गु another bird.

m. (-सिः)
A cloud.
E.
जल, and मसि ink; composed as it were of ink and water, alluding to its dark colour.

m. (-र्गः)
A drain or issue from a pond, &c.
E.
जल water, and मार्ग a road, a watercourse.

m. (-रः)
An otter.
E.
जल water, and मार्ज्जार a cat.

m. (-मुक्)
A cloud.
E.
जल, and मुच् from मुच् to set free, affix क्विप्, liberating.

m. (-र्त्तिः)
ŚIVA.
E.
जल, and मूर्त्ति form; of whom one form is water; implying his omnipresence.

f. (-का)
Hail.
E.
जल, and मूर्त्ति form, with कन् added; a form or condition of water.

n. (-दं)
A fragrant grass, (Andropogon muricatum.)
E.
जल, and मोद what delights.

n. (-लं)
1 A stream.
2 Collyrium.

n. (-न्त्रं)
A waterwork, a machine for raising water, &c., any contrivance connected with that element.
E.
जल, and यन्त्र a machine.

n. (-हं)
A house or fabric erected in the midst of water, or subterraneous apartments constructed in the bank of a river, for retiring to in the hot season; a summer house, &c.
E.
जलयन्त्र a waterwork, and गृह a house; also similar compounds, as जलयत्त्रनिकेतन, जलयन्त्रमन्दिरं, &c.

m. (-ङ्कः)
A kind of crane, (Ardea nivea.)
E.
जल, and रङ्क miserly, greedy of water; feeding on small fish chiefly, and therefore haunting swamps, &c.

m. (-ङ्कुः)
A gallinule.
E.
जल, and रङ्कु a sort of deer; the water-deer.

m. (-ञ्जः)
The Vaka, (Ardea nivea.)
E.
जल, रजि to be fond of, affix घञ्.

m. (-ण्डः)
1 A whirlpool.
2 A drop or a thin sprinkling of water.
3 A snake.
E.
जल, and लडि to tremble, to play, &c. affix अच, and ल becomes र.

n. (-सं)
Salt.
E.
जल water, and रस taste, essence.

f. (-शिः)
A piece of water, a quantity of water.
E.
जल, and राशि a heap.

m. (-रुट्)
A lotus.
E.
जल water, रुह to mount, affix क्विप्; also with क affix, जलरुह n. (-हं.)

m. (-पः)
The fish of KĀMADEVA.
E.
जल, and रूप form.

f. (-ता)
A wave, a billow.
E.
जल water, and लता a creeping plant.

m. (-ण्टः)
A watery pustule, a sort of watery pox.

n. (-लं)
An aquatic plant, (Pistia stratiotes.)
E.
जल, and वल्कक bark, rind.

m. (-सः)
A bird, the diver.
E.
जल, and वायस a crow, the water-crow; also जलकाक.

m. (-कः)
The Vindhya mountain.
E.
जल water, वाड to dive, and ण्वुल् affix; ड changed to ल; alluding to the many streams that rise in this range.

f. (-का)
Lightning.
E.
जल water, and वालिका offspring, engendered at the rainy season.

m. (-हः)
1 A cloud.
2 A water carrier.
E.
जल, and वह to bear, affix घञ्.

n. (-नं)
Flowing of water.
f. (-नी)
A watercourse, an aqueduct.
E.
जल, and वाहन bearing.

m. (-लः)
An otter.
E.
जल, and विडाल a cat; the water-cat.

f. (-न्दुः)
A drop of water.
E.
जल, and विन्दु a drop.

m. (-ल्वः)
1 A crab.
2 A tortoise.
3 A piece of water.
E.
जल, and विल्व a particular tree and fruit.

n. (-वं)
The autumnal equinox, the moment of the sun's entering Libra.
E.
जल, and विषुव equinox; the watery equinox, occurring near the close of the annual rains.

m. (-कः)
A prawn or shrimp.
E.
जल water, वृश्चिक a scorpion.

m. (-धः)
A kind of fish, (Esox cancila, HAM.)
E.
जल, and व्यध to pierce, affix अच्.

m. (-लः)
1 A water-snake.
2 A marine monster.
E.
जल, and व्याल a snake.

m. (-यः)
VIṢṆU.
E.
जल water, and शय who sleeps; he is supposed to sleep, borne by his serpent couch above the ocean, during the four months of the periodical rains in India; also during the intervals of the submersion of the world.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
Stupid, dull, cold, apathetic.
m. (-यः)
1 A pond, a tank, a lake, a reservoir or any piece of water.
2 The ocean.
n. (-यं)
A fragrant grass, (Andropogon muricatum.)
E.
जल water, and आशय an abode or receptacle, or जल for जड cold, and आशय disposition.

m. (-नः)
VIṢṆU.
E.
जल water, शि to sleep, affix ल्यु, see the preceding.

m. (-यी)
VIṢṆU.
E.
जल, and शायिन् who sleeps: see the preceding.

mfn. (-यी-यिनी-यि)
Lying or sleeping in water as a penance.
E.
जल, and शी to sleep or lie, with आङ् prefixed, and णिनि aff.

m. (-क्तिः)
A bivalve shell.
E.
जल, and शुक्ति an oyster.

mfn. (-चिः-चिः-चि)
Bathed, washed.
E.
जल, and शुचि cleansing.

m. (-चिः)
1 A fish, a small sort of pike, (Esox cancila, HAM.)
2 The gangetic porpoise.
3 A heron.
4 An aquatic plant, (Trapa bispinosa.)
f. (-चिः)
A leech.
E.
जल water, and सूचि a needle.

m. (-कः)
Vallisneria.
E.
जल, and शूक the beard of corn, &c.

m. (-रः)
A crocodile.
E.
जल, and शूकर a hog, the water-hog.

m. (-र्गः)
Mixture with water, dilution.
E.
जल, and संसग combination.

f. (-णी)
A leech.
E.
जल water, सृप to go or creep, affix णिनि and ङीष्.

mfn. (-स्थः-स्था-स्थं)
Being or abiding in water.
E.
जल, and स्थ who or what stays.

n. (-हं)
A small water (or summer) house.
E.
जल water, and हा to quit, affix डः see जलयन्त्रगृह, &c.

m. (-सः)
Cuttle fish bone, considered as the indurated foam of the sea; also जलहासक.
E.
जल water, and हास laugh, smile; alluding to its white colour.

f. (-क्षी)
An aquatic plant, (Commelina salicifolia.)
E.
जल, and अक्ष the eye, affix ङीष्: see जलपिप्पली.

m. (-खुः)
An otter.
E.
जल, and आखु a cat.

n. (-लं)
1 A natural water-course or channel.
2 A plant, (Vallisneria.)
E.
जल, and अञ्चल end of a garment.

f. (-लिः)
A handful of water, or water held in the palms of the hand, as presented in oblation, &c.
E.
जल, and अञ्जलि salutation.

m. (-नः)
A heron.
f. (-नी)
A leech.
E.
जल water, अट to go, affixes ल्युट् and ङीष्.

mfn. (-ढ्यः-ढ्या-ढ्यं)
Watery, marshy.
E.
जल, and आद्य rich, abounding.

m. (-कः)
A shark, or according to some a large alligator, &c.: see ग्राह.
E.
जल water, अटि to go, क्वन् aff.

m. (-कः)
Small fry.
E.
जल water, अण्ड an egg, and कन् aff.

f. (-का)
1 A leech.
2 A well.
E.
जल, and आत्मा being, existence, ठक् aff.

m. (-र्शः)
Water reflecting any object, a watery mirror.
E.
जल, and आदर्श a mirror.

m. (-तः)
A name of VARUṆA.
n. (-तं)
The asterism Pūrvāṣāḍhā.
E.
जल water, अधि over, and दैवत divinity; the possessor of divine supremacy over the element of water.

m. (-रः)
Going or acting like water.
E.
जल, and अनुसार agreeing with.

m. (-कः)
Sprinkling with water.
E.
जल, and अभिषेक aspersion.

f. (-का)
A well.
E.
जल, and अम्बिका a mother; bearing water as it were in its womb: the word is sometimes read जलात्मिका.

f. (-का)
A leech.
E.
जल water, अय to go, उकच् aff.

m. (-वः)
1 The rainy season.
2 The sea of fresh water.
E.
जल water, and अर्णव a sea.

mfn. (-र्थी-र्थिणी-र्थि)
Thirsty, desirous of water.
E.
जल, and अर्थिन् desirous of.

mfn. subst. (-र्द्रः-र्द्रा-र्द्रं)
Wet cloth or clothes.
adj.
Wet, charged with aqueous moisture.
E.
जल water, and आर्द्र damp, moist.

f. (-का)
A leech.
E.
